mode: Two read-only unauthenticated public GETs; no cookies, credentials, LLM or content writes.

translation_reason.description: Optional on error results. Not-found means a successful lookup found no matching chapter/block in the requested chapter, which can indicate stale or incorrectly grouped IDs. Database-unavailable means the lookup failed; it does not establish that data is missing.

translation_retryable.description: Optional on error results. True allows a bounded retry after a failed database read; false means retrying the same chapter/IDs is not useful without refreshing or correcting the request. Absence does not imply success.

expected_fields.position_description: Saves the authenticated user's reading position with a conditional commit against the server snapshot. An existing row is updated only while its updated_at still matches the snapshot; competing initial inserts never replace the winning row. Each successful position save advances updated_at, including saves within the same millisecond. A rejected client timestamp or concurrent change returns HTTP 200 with success:true, persisted:false, reason:stale_client and the current server position (nullable if the row disappeared); it is not HTTP 409. Intentional backwards navigation remains valid against a current snapshot. The existing client timestamp comparison remains in effect and is not a total ordering of actions across device clocks. Guests are acknowledged without persistence.

limitation: Public health/schema smoke confirms availability and deployed contract. It does not exercise a translation, position mutation, authentication, model or production database write.
